verdict.rationale: Figma offers concrete design-to-code paths: Code Connect maps design system components to true production code snippets shown in Dev Mode, and the MCP server can generate code from selected frames while pulling variables/components/layout as context, with Code Connect keeping generated code consistent with the real codebase. However, community feedback shows friction in practice (manual SVG export workflows, complaints about generated CSS using absolute positioning), and Dev Mode/MCP features are gated behind paid tiers. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that MCP-generated code is production-ready/shippable without heavy manual cleanup, broader framework coverage beyond React examples, and resolution of community complaints about output quality (e.g., absolute-positioning CSS).
